Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The mapper reads the live tool registry for each request. The call adapters preserve call IDs and MCP error data. The local fallback validates arguments and requires confirmation for tools outside its read-only list.

Local validation used a clean trial merge with upstream/main at 2f6de7c5b0eb7eb9053ce086a8e4705fc0776a78. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- App library and all 36 MCP suites: 478 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored. This includes all nine new integration tests and six new unit tests.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The gate dry run included unrelated upstream changes because the trial merge was not committed. Validation used the touched app library and MCP suites directly.

Requested before merge: none.

This PR does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. It prepares calls and does not execute them. No safety-tier mutation rerun was required or performed. No goldens moved. No UI files changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.

The offline checks do not test live provider requests or streaming. The caller must preserve the original response for reasoning items and thought signatures. The existing material schema excludes null from its enum; the validator preserves that restriction, as the decision record states.

Format references checked: [Anthropic](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/handle-tool-calls), [OpenAI](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/function-calling), and [Gemini](https://ai.google.dev/api/caching#FunctionDeclaration).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
